Messages.Author: PDB6
Messages.Body:
The VEKN is currently looking for more brave soul-less types to volunteer as
official Clan Newsletter writers. This past month, we had a Nosferatu and a
Settite newsletters, and hopefully this April we will have even more. There
are currently 7 writers, and we would like more, first to fill out the basic
Camarilla clans, and then to cover all the rest if possible. So far the
Nosferatu, Followers of Set, Anti-Gangrel, Tremere, Toreador, and Ravanos are
covered, and we would like volunteers for:

Gangrel
Ventrue
Brujah
Malkavians

most of all, but any other clan you are real hip to would be good.

Our aim is to post newsletters on the first of every month that include some
sort of storytelling element and any sort of clan specific strategy discussion,
including deck designs, tactics, specific card combos, or whatever.

The only requirement to be a Newsletter Writer (we are hoping to come up with a
better title than that...) is a basic understanding of the game and the
willingness to post them on a regular basis.

If you are interested, please e-mail me at:
PD...@aol.com

Thanks,

Peter D Bakija
PD...@aol.com

"They come at night.
Mostly."
-Newt
